description: Map XML tags to paragraph, character, table or cell styles and style the tagged content (Structure pane or Tags panel menu > Map Tags to Styles), or map styles to tags and tag the styled content (Map Styles to Tags). Maps are kept in the document; map_by_name pairs tags and styles of the same name

apply.description: Apply the maps now: style the tagged content, or tag the styled content

includeMasterPageStories.description: styles_to_tags: include stories on parent (master) pages

includePasteboardStories.description: styles_to_tags: include stories on the pasteboard

mapByName.description: Also map every tag and paragraph or character style that share a name (Map By Name)

maps.description: Tag and style pairs to add or change

tag.description: Tag name (for styles_to_tags, created if missing)

replace.description: Remove the existing maps of this direction first

name: map_xml_tags_and_styles
title: Map XML Tags And Styles
